instructionsMd: Select the TWO choices that complete the sentence coherently and give it equivalent meanings.
explanationMd: Applying the same standards regardless of personal relationship supports impartial and unbiased. The sentence concerns fairness, not anonymity or perfect judgment.

distractorRationale.f: Fair standards do not guarantee freedom from error.
